name: assertify
description: Let Claude use any website you're logged in to. Log in once; the session stays encrypted on your machine.
long_description: Assertify gives Claude a real browser that is already logged in as you. You sign in once in a normal browser window (2FA, passkeys and SSO all work), and the session is saved AES-256-GCM encrypted with a key in your OS keychain. You can save several accounts per site (named after their emails) and use one or all of them at once. Claude can then open headless, logged-in sessions to read, click, type, upload files and take screenshots. Each login is locked to its own domains, risky clicks (send, buy, delete) wait for your OK, and logins can be read-only. It acts like a person (real Chrome, natural mouse and typing), handles pop-ups, and hands CAPTCHAs, 2FA and expired logins back to you. Assertify itself sends nothing anywhere: there is no server, no account and no telemetry. It can also drive your own phone: an Android phone over adb, or your iPhone through macOS iPhone Mirroring, with the same confirm-before-sending rules.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List saved website logins: name, account (e.g. the email), site, allowed domains, read-only.

tools.name: start_login
tools.description: Open a visible browser window so the USER can log in to a site by hand.

tools.name: complete_login
tools.description: Save the logged-in session from the login window (encrypted) and close the window.

tools.name: rename_profile
tools.description: Rename a saved login, e.g. "google.com-1" -> "work".

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a saved login from disk.

tools.name: open_session
tools.description: Open a headless browser already logged in as the saved profile. Returns a session id and page snapshot.

tools.name: open_sessions
tools.description: Open several logins at once, e.g. every saved Gmail account, each in its own browser.

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close a session. With save=True (default), refreshed cookies are written back to the vault.

tools.name: save_session
tools.description: Write the session's current cookies/storage back to the encrypted vault.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Let the USER take over in a visible window: CAPTCHAs, 2FA prompts, expired logins, anything

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Current URL, title and a list of interactive elements with [eN] refs to use in other tools.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Search the whole page (not just the first items of the snapshot) for elements whose label,

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL (must be within the profile's allowed domains).

tools.name: back
tools.description: Browser back button.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element: `ref` from the latest snapshot (e.g. "e12"), or its visible `text`

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Replace the contents of a text field with `text`. Pick the field by `ref` or its visible `label`.

tools.name: upload_files
tools.description: Attach files or a whole folder from your computer to a page (photos for a post, a PDF for an email), the way the browser's file dialog does.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose an option (by visible label or value) in a <select> element, picked by `ref` or `label`.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the page, e.g. "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "Control+A".

tools.name: dismiss_popup
tools.description: Close the pop-up on top of the page (cookie banner, "share your info", newsletter, app promo...)

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page "up" or "down" by `amount` pixels (lazy-loaded content appears in the next snapshot).

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until `text` appears on the page (up to 15s), or just wait `seconds`.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Return the visible text of the page (for reading content, tables, messages, etc.).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the current page, or just one element (ref from the latest snapshot).

tools.name: set_screenshots
tools.description: Turn per-step screenshots on or off for a session (each action then returns a screenshot).

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make tab `index` (0-based) the active tab. New tabs/popups become active automatically.

tools.name: phone_devices
tools.description: List phones Assertify can drive: Android over adb, and the iPhone shown in macOS iPhone Mirroring.

tools.name: phone_snapshot
tools.description: Outline of what is on the phone screen with [pN] refs, plus the open app.

tools.name: phone_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the phone; shown to the agent and saved to a private file.

tools.name: phone_tap
tools.description: Tap on the phone by ref, visible text, or screenshot x/y. Send/post/buy taps need confirmation.

tools.name: phone_type
tools.description: Type text on the phone, optionally into a field by ref. Never types into password or PIN fields.

tools.name: phone_press
tools.description: Press a phone key: home, back, recents, enter, delete...

tools.name: phone_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the phone screen up, down, left or right.

tools.name: phone_swipe
tools.description: Swipe between two points of the latest phone screenshot.

tools.name: phone_open
tools.description: Open an app on the phone by name, or a link (Android).
